fields.why: The headline compares the 2021 national rate with the 2010–2020 median of the same ArboNET series, which is a period comparison of one series (pair) under the repeated-measurements rule. Reading the historical median as a fixed baseline (fixed referent) is also defensible.

brief_issues: The brief does not say whether a historical baseline (median or average of prior years of the same series) is a fixed referent or the other period of a pair.
